question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Viable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Impracticable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Viable"** means something that is capable of working successfully; feasible. (संभव)

 
 
• **Example: **With the new funding, the project is now financially viable.
 
 
 
• **"Impracticable"** refers to something that is not capable of being carried out or put into practice; not feasible. (अव्यवहारिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The plan to build a bridge in just one month is impracticable given the current resources.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Viable'** is **'Impracticable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Impracticable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inaccurate **(अशुद्ध): Not accurate; incorrect or untrue.

 
 
• **Example:** The report was filled with inaccurate information.
 
 
 
• **Indignant **(क्रोधित): Feeling or showing anger or annoyance at what is perceived as unfair treatment.
 
 
• **Example: **She was indignant at the way she had been treated by her boss.
 
 
 
• **Irresolvable** (असमाधेय): Not able to be resolved or settled.
 
 
• **Example:** The conflict between the two countries seemed irresolvable.
